ext_description.message: Debugging tool that intercepts and overrides network API responses from DevTools panel or popup. For developers only.

api_export_har_title.message: Export the captured requests as a HAR file

api_mock_edit_title.message: Edit the rule that already covers this request

api_mock_new_title.message: Open the rule editor filled from this request

conditions_help.message: Match only some requests. Every condition you fill in must hold, together with the URL pattern and method. Leave them blank to match every request.

detail_no_server.message: Answered in the browser; the server is never called

detail_patch.message: Changes these fields of the real JSON response:

empty_captured.message: No network requests captured yet. Refresh page or trigger APIs.

empty_overridden.message: No captured requests match active overrides.

error_background_no_confirm.message: Background did not confirm the update

error_body_not_json.message: Response body is not valid JSON.

error_delay_range.message: Delay must be between 0 and 120000 ms.

error_redirect_required.message: Redirect URL is required for a redirect override.

error_request_headers.message: Request headers must use one “Header-Name: value” per line.

error_response_headers.message: Extra response headers must use one “Header-Name: value” per line.

error_status_range.message: Status code must be between 100 and 599.

error_ws_delay.message: Delay frame needs a delay above 0 ms.

error_ws_pattern.message: A WebSocket pattern starts with ws://, wss:// or *.

error_ws_regex.message: Match is not a valid regular expression: $1

error_ws_substitute.message: Substitute needs a Match to replace.

field_delay_hint.message: Wait this long before answering, to test loading states. 3000 = 3 seconds.

field_fail_hint.message: The error the page sees instead of a response.

field_global_hint.message: Off: the rule only works on the site it was made on.

field_global_title.message: Apply this rule on every domain

field_graphql_hint.message: The operation name the page sends to a GraphQL endpoint.

field_match_body_placeholder.message: e.g. "plan":"pro" (no match when the browser sends no body text)

field_match_headers.message: Request headers (one per line; names ignore case)

field_mode_hint.message: Text answers with the body as typed. Patch changes a few fields of the real response; Script computes the answer.

field_patch_help.message: The request goes to the server and only these fields of its JSON response change. One change per line: set data.user.plan = "pro" (the value is JSON) or remove data.ads. Paths use dots and [0] for array items, or a JSON Pointer such as /data/items/0. A response that is not JSON passes through unchanged.

field_pattern_hint.message: Part of the URL. Use * to match more URLs, e.g. /api/users/*; /regex/ also works.

field_query_placeholder.message: e.g. page=2&debug (a name alone: present with any value)

field_request_body.message: Replace the request body sent to the server

field_request_headers.message: Request headers to add or replace (Key-Value or Raw)

field_respond_hint.message: The server is never contacted: works for endpoints that do not exist yet.

field_respond_title.message: Fulfil the request in the browser with this body, status and headers. The server is never contacted, so this works for unreachable hosts and endpoints that do not exist yet.

field_response_headers.message: Headers to add to the response (Key-Value or Raw)

field_script_help.message: The body of an async function that receives request and returns the response: a string, or { status, headers, body }. It runs in the page. request has url, method, headers, query, params, body and the original response.

field_templates_hint.message: Placeholders such as $1 get a fresh value on every request.

field_templates_title.message: Resolve dynamic {{...}} placeholders at request time

hint_tip.message: Tip: use * as wildcard in patterns (e.g., https://old.com/api/*/users), */all for all requests, or regex /pattern/flags. Use * in Redirect URL to substitute captured wildcards.

hits_idle.message: Not applied yet, although requests went by.

hits_idle_check.message: Check the pattern, the method and the conditions.

hits_none.message: Not applied yet in this session

import_curl_title.message: Make rules from a cURL command or an OpenAPI / Swagger spec

import_merge_message.message: Rules already exist for this domain. Choose how the imported rules should be added.

import_other_domain_message.message: This file was exported from “$1”, but the active domain is “$2”.

import_paste.message: Paste a cURL command or an OpenAPI / Swagger spec (JSON or YAML)

import_paste_placeholder.message:
curl -X POST https://api.example.com/users -H "Authorization: Bearer token" -d '{"name":"John"}'

Or paste Swagger/OpenAPI JSON content...

import_rules_file_title.message: Load rules exported from this extension

import_title.message: Import rules from cURL or OpenAPI / Swagger

preset_empty_list_title.message: Answer 200 with an empty list: [] or the same JSON with its lists emptied

preset_offline_title.message: Fail the request as if the network were down

preset_server_error_title.message: Answer with status 500 and a small JSON error

preset_slow_title.message: Wait 3 seconds before the answer arrives

profile_delete_message.message: Delete profile “$1”? This cannot be undone.

profile_name_placeholder.message: e.g. Staging Mock or Error Flow

profile_save_message.message: Save the current rules as a reusable profile for this domain.

reset_counts_title.message: Set the applied count of every rule back to 0

rule_drag_title.message: Drag to reorder, or press the up and down arrow keys

toast_applied.message: $1 and applied to the active tab.

toast_disabled_sync_failed.message: Disabled setting saved, but the background update failed: $1

toast_enabled_sync_failed.message: Enabled setting saved, but the background update failed: $1

toast_har_empty.message: Nothing captured yet; there is nothing to export.

toast_har_exported.message: Exported $1 request(s), $2 with a response body.

toast_har_no_tab.message: No active tab to export from.

toast_import_nothing.message: Could not parse any rules from cURL, HAR file, or Swagger/OpenAPI specification.

toast_import_read_failed.message: Could not read the selected import file.

toast_invalid_file_rule.message: Invalid file: a rule has a missing or invalid field.

toast_pattern_required.message: Pattern is required before adding a rule.

toast_persist_disabled_failed.message: Could not persist the disabled interception state: $1

toast_profile_needs_domain.message: A page domain is required before saving a profile.

toast_retry_done.message: Interception updated for the active tab.

type_body_title.message: Answer with your own status and body

type_fail_title.message: Make the request fail as if the network broke

type_redirect_title.message: Send the request to another URL
